text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Bid Award Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office ending December 31, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
The Bid Award Panel: 1. Elected David McLeod as Vice Chair of the Bid Award Panel for a term of office starting January 3, 2018 and ending December 31, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
